summary.text: Light shine fungi are a deep-sea desolate plant that emits strong light from light path dao marks.

claims.text: Tong Hua finds green fungus on the surface of corals in a dark Eastern Sea deep, names it light shine fungus, and presents it as a desolate plant that contains light path dao marks and can emit strong light. Fang Yuan recognizes light shine fungi as soon as she finishes the account.

Light shine fungus is a desolate plant that provides light unlike multicolored aurora light. Fang Yuan wants light shine fungi for mass production of multicolored overlord flowers and considers later wood path modification toward aurora light shine fungi. Tong Hua trades desolate plant light shine fungi for storey building water elephants, then plans to sell them in treasure yellow heaven rather than for immortal essence stones. The light shine fungus is a rank six desolate plant; once researched, seekers can find more across Eastern Sea and the supply can rise sharply.

Light shine fungi live deep in Eastern Sea in pure darkness and emit intense light that turns the dark sea bright like daytime. Outside that dark, high-pressure habitat they do not die, but they shrivel and emit only a weak candle-like light. Fang Yuan buys all of Tong Hua’s light shine fungi in treasure yellow heaven at the lowest price, places a portion in Mini Eastern Sea, and experiments on the rest to modify the plant.

Fang Yuan’s immortal killer move light fungus radiance turns green light shine fungi into pure white light shine fungi suited for the sky. The pure white light shine fungi radiate strong light instead of wilting, float in Mini Orange Heaven and Mini White Heaven, and support aurora lights and multicolored overlord flowers. He plans to nurture both versions: green light shine fungi in Mini Eastern Sea, and mostly pure white light shine fungi for his own needs and later sale.
